connector.description: Manage contacts and send messages in Acme.
parameter.acme.resource.description: The kind of record to work with.
parameter.acme.updateFields.description: Fields to change on the contact.
parameter.acme.returnAll.description: Whether to return every contact instead of the first ones up to the limit.
parameter.acme.limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.
parameter.acme.updatedAfter.description: Only contacts changed after this moment (RFC 3339, UTC).
parameter.acme.to.description: E-mail address the message is sent to.
operation.message.send.manualCheck: Open the sent messages in Acme and look for a message to {{ $parameter.to }} sent around {{ $intent.sentAt }}.
error.contact.create.conflict: A contact with this e-mail address already exists in Acme.
error.message.send.uncertain: Acme answered with a server error after the message was sent; check whether it was delivered.
changelog.1.0.0.first: First release: contacts (create, get, get many, update, delete) and messages (send).
